svg.title: Felinaut icon board — conceptual reference
svg.desc: Original vector design reference, not an actual browser screenshot. Canonical astronaut-cat assets and all six current theme palettes. Current static compositions and future personality concepts are labeled separately.
svg.text: CONCEPTUAL REFERENCE · NOT A PRODUCT SCREENSHOT
Canonical full-color identity at optical sizes; existing monochrome UI icons keep their functional meaning.

svg.title: Felinaut astronaut cat symbol
svg.desc: Felinaut, the happy female orange-and-cream explorer cat, has pointed ears and joyful crescent eyes inside a round cyan astronaut helmet. One open smile and a tiny tongue keep her face welcoming. A white and lavender rim and compact neck seal preserve the silhouette at small sizes. Original vector artwork on transparency.

svg.text: Soft deep-space tile, not a new character.
An illustration study, not a shipped .icns export.
